sloka: अयमनघ तवोदितः प्रियार्थं जनकसुतानिधनं निरीक्ष्य रुष्टः।सहयगजरथां सराक्षसेन्द्रां भृशमिषुभिर्विनिपातयामि लङ्काम् ।। ६.८३.४४ ।।
transliteration: ayamanagha tavoditaḥ priyārthaṁ janakasutānidhanaṁ nirīkṣya ruṣṭaḥ।sahayagajarathāṁ sarākṣasendrāṁ bhṛśamiṣubhirvinipātayāmi laṅkām ।। 6.83.44 ।।

translations.english: 'O sinless one, all this I have said only for your pleasure. Enraged at beholding the death of Janaka's daughter, I shall lay low with my arrows this whole Lanka, with its horses, elephants and chariots, together with the lord of the rakshasas.'
